notes: P25 goals score fictional Bike Atlas reference builds, not purchasing advice or manufacturer recommendations.
Hard compatibility/system constraints are applied before preference scoring.
Goal weights explain relative search priorities and are intentionally inspectable.

goals.name: Speed
goals.description: Prioritize flat-road speed, low drag and low mass while retaining usable top gearing.

goals.name: Climbing
goals.description: Prioritize steep-gradient speed, low mass and genuinely low gearing with adequate range.

goals.name: Mixed Surface
goals.description: Balance hardpack efficiency with tire volume, low gearing, braking and stable geometry.

goals.name: Comfort
goals.description: Prioritize a less aggressive contact-point position, useful tire volume and calm steering.

goals.name: Utility
goals.description: Prioritize stable, upright, durable-reference configuration with broad gearing and practical surface capability.
